title: Shiv — Discover
description: Stimulating finds beyond the usual queue — economics, institutions, history, and ideas worth sitting with. Private discovery feed for Apple Podcasts.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: The Rocky Statue (99% Invisible)
items.description:
99% Invisible on how a movie prop became a civic monument in Philadelphia — and how the crowd’s claim beat the art establishment over what represents a place.

Watch: https://youtu.be/PcpttgVTlIQ

Episode: https://99percentinvisible.org/episode/684-the-rocky-statue/

items.title: Middlegarchs are the new Oligarchs (Planet Money)
items.description:
Planet Money on “middlegarchs”: stealth millionaires who shape markets without oligarch-scale brand gravity — a clearer map of soft power in the middle of the wealth distribution.

Watch: https://youtu.be/_y8FrkZXvXA

Episode: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/25/nx-s1-5981194/stealthy-wealthy-everywhere-millionaires-pass-through

items.title: Democratic Socialism. Hope or Hopeless? (Throughline)
items.description:
Throughline on Michael Harrington’s path from Catholic radical to Democratic loyalist — when compromise builds power, and when it dissolves the movement.

Watch: https://youtu.be/5NbIJDnGkqQ

Episode: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/24/nx-s1-5979087/democratic-socialism-hope-or-hopeless

items.title: Gita Gopinath on Trade, Currencies, and Economic Transformation (Conversations with Tyler)
items.description:
Tyler Cowen with IMF deputy MD Gita Gopinath on dollar dominance, sovereign debt plumbing, and how currencies reshape trade and economic transformation.

Watch: https://youtu.be/MPXd2pa5V9Y

Episode: https://cowenconvos.libsyn.com/gita-gopinath-on-trade-currencies-and-economic-transformation

items.title: Jared Diamond on Leaders, Luck, and Irreplaceability (Conversations with Tyler)
items.description:
Tyler Cowen with Jared Diamond on leaders, luck, and irreplaceability — when individuals actually move history across prophets, CEOs, and coaches.

Watch: https://youtu.be/SwcVPrH_waU

Episode: https://conversationswithtyler.com/episodes/jared-diamond/

items.title: 687. Are Prediction Markets the Best Forecasting Tool Ever — or Just Another Casino? (Freakonomics Radio)
items.description:
Freakonomics Radio on prediction markets: best forecasting tool ever, or sports-bet liquidity dressed as civic tech — and how Kalshi and experts frame “information” vs entertainment.

Watch: https://youtu.be/UDyQLVhGiIY

Episode: https://freakonomics.com/podcast/are-prediction-markets-the-best-forecasting-tool-ever-or-just-another-casino/

items.title: The loan at the heart of a new foreclosure crisis (Planet Money)
items.description:
Planet Money on DSCR loans: rental cash-flow underwriting that scales investor portfolios — and how one Baltimore stack shows GFC-style risk returning under a new label.

Watch: https://youtu.be/JcBRR4ftTQE

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-loan-at-the-heart-of-a-new-foreclosure-crisis/id290783428?i=1000789070345

items.title: The Domino’s Pizza Tracker Theory of Everything (Planet Money)
items.description:
Planet Money on the Domino’s pizza tracker as labor illusion — progress UI that makes waiting feel like work being done, and the economics hiding in a pizza app.

Watch: https://youtu.be/r2oo0u2Zpdw

Episode: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/18/nx-s1-5974101/dominos-pizza-tracker-labor-illusion

items.title: Talent, Time and Money: The Curse of General Magic (Cautionary Tales with Tim Harford)
items.description:
Cautionary Tales on General Magic: talent, nearly unlimited cash, and a fifteen-year head start on the smartphone — and why constraints, not abundance, often decide who wins.

Watch: https://youtu.be/JE7XMevEFTg

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/talent-time-and-money-the-curse-of-general-magic/id1484511465?i=1000788891693

items.title: Annie Lowrey on the Time Tax, Fraud, and Rationing by Paperwork (Conversations with Tyler)
items.description:
Tyler Cowen with Annie Lowrey on the time tax: hours spent on hold, in waiting rooms, and filling forms — and whether bureaucracy is a regressive levy or a quiet rationing tool.

Watch: https://youtu.be/o0ZDf0bgEXE

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/annie-lowrey-on-the-time-tax-fraud-and-rationing/id983795625?i=1000790017400

items.title: 706. Queen Victoria’s Revenge: Storming the Citadel (Part 2) (The Rest Is History)
items.description:
The Rest Is History concludes Queen Victoria’s Abyssinian expedition: Napier’s rescue of European hostages, the storming of Magdala, and one of the empire’s most epic campaigns.

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/queen-victorias-revenge-storming-the-citadel-part-2/id1537788786?i=1000789062489&uo=4

items.title: Incentives Are for Losers (with Adam Mastroianni) (EconTalk)
items.description:
EconTalk with Adam Mastroianni: when following bad incentives is “loser behavior” — and why figuring out right from wrong yourself is harder than maximizing the scoreboard.

Watch: https://youtu.be/XEislRTN_F8

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/incentives-are-for-losers-with-adam-mastroianni/id135066958?i=1000789541014

items.title: Show 74 - Mania for Subjugation IV (Hardcore History)
items.description:
Dan Carlin’s Hardcore History on the Battle of Issus — Alexander versus Persia’s Great King in a showdown often skipped by Hollywood but decisive in ancient history.

Watch: https://youtu.be/Gu4syP_IzQs

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/mania-for-subjugation-iv/id173001861?i=1000779313976
